summary: Retain incarnation-fenced PTY exit status and redacted output for failed agent and mission inspection

replay.detail: No historical process output is reconstructed. Incarnations that ended before exit receipts were retained remain without that evidence. New runtime observations replicate the captured evidence.

schema.detail: The claim registry adds optional runtime.observed exit_evidence. No SQLite schema, index, trigger or storage version changes. Registry and replication compatibility digests change.

rules.detail: One-shot completion still selects reversible stop. No restart, retry, admission or checkpoint policy changes. Evidence remains fenced to the exact process incarnation.

compatibility.detail: Subject inspection includes exit code, signal and a bounded tail normalized by the shared transcript redaction policy. A waiting mission step and run include the retained failure explanation instead of only missing-agent admission text. Older registries retain unfamiliar exit_evidence observations as unknown-field waiting records until upgraded.

downtime.detail: No startup migration or recovery scan is added. Existing running processes must be launched by the updated PTY producer to retain the new receipt.

manual.detail: Deploy the matching PTY producer and Fractal reader together, and upgrade claim-registry readers before relying on replicated exit evidence.

recovery.detail: PTY cleanup no longer destroys the incarnation exit receipt. Fractal preserves captured evidence across subsequent stop observations; replacement incarnations do not inherit it. Rolling back stops new evidence capture and leaves unfamiliar observations waiting for a compatible reader.
